important.problem: The prepare roster predicate uses all(...) without the exact 18 IDs/cardinality, so [] and partial/duplicated rosters satisfy it. prepared.files can likewise be empty. The reader checks original launcher request JSON and successful Job observations separately, but never requires or binds original launcher stdout.raw/stderr.raw, exact output paths or an actual invocation/request pair; the outer tool raw result is checked only for exit_code==0. Thus the claimed complete actual prepare chain can be accepted with missing roster/raw provenance or an unrelated successful observation.
important.evidence_kind: Static source reasoning; all future controls remain NOT_RUN.

Require a nonempty, duplicate-free prepared-file set rooted in the bound work_root and matched to the real complete prepared closure. Extend the prepared proof contract with exact original launcher stdout/stderr refs, invocation/request/full output-manifest binding and original outer invocation+completion pairing. Require proof paths to the bound prepare output/launcher namespaces and check requested cwd ROOT. Do not mint substitute success/native-exit fields; retain outer-native NULL where no explicit bridge exists.

important.problem: The registration source review is bound to tuples, program/input hashes and copied original canonical bytes, but its current scope/draft/desired-input relation is not checked. The actual invocation only needs len(argv)>=6 and the Python/flags/register prefix; arguments selecting the binding/draft, review, output namespace and cwd are ignored. registration_namespace is syntactically checked in scope() but never used to bind these evidence paths. The available owned helper result contains no argv (helper lines69-83), so job(result) cannot close this gap. A review or successful registration invocation for another draft at the same baseline can therefore be substituted without the reader detecting the missing relation.
important.evidence_kind: Static source reasoning against actual r329 public receipt shapes; r329 is provenance only and is not claimed fresh driver authority.
important.minimum_fix: Define and check exact current_scope_ref and registration_draft_ref in the independent registration review, and bind its prepared_refs/draft manifest to these exact four original and desired refs. Bind the original owned invocation/request to the complete reviewed argv, cwd ROOT, draft/binding ref, review ref and designated registration namespace; require the actual final registration envelope/manifest to preserve that pairing. Keep the pre-execution audit source/draft hash separate from the post-execution audit_ref so the review→intent→actual-audit chain remains acyclic. The actual Root writer/wrapper/sealer implementation is still OPEN and must be independently reviewed.
